title: Update through the recorded distribution
need: yoke update reuses the machine distribution origin/channel, reports verified old/new versions and repairs the credential helper. Distribution is not the active control-plane connection. Missing records need explicit distribution selection. yoke update --check proves the exact installed build: the CLI wheel's full source commit (scm_version.json) must equal the release manifest's source_commit, and the release's published wheel sha256 values are listed; a mismatch refuses installed_build_mismatch with the exact-version reinstall command. With no usable active connection, --check refuses active_connection_unavailable and names `yoke env use <env>` (list with `yoke env list`) instead of a traceback. --check reports behind as cli, server, cli and server, or none; when the CLI is behind against a self-hosted team server it names `yoke self-host upgrade --channel <channel>` on the server's machine, which moves CLI and server together, or else yoke update plus the server admin. yoke self-host upgrade removes the replaced server image only after the restarted server reports healthy; a failed removal is a warning naming the image, Docker's error and `docker image rm <image>`, the upgrade still succeeds, and the receipt carries previous_image_removed. yoke --version prints only the version. Registered folders that are no longer Git repositories emit a not_a_repo warning in the helper receipt without blocking CLI activation; yoke project uninstall on the owning connection removes exactly that stale registration, preserving files, layers, trust and all other registrations. Valid repositories with unreadable Git config still refuse.
surface: Install -> upgrade instructions -> CLI/config -> distribution help.
